visible_text: 若 p 及 q 均為常數使得 px(x - 1) + x^2 ≡ qx(x - 2) + 4x，則 p = A. 1 B. 2 C. 3 D. 4
reasoning: Expanding both sides yields (p+1)x^2 - p x = q x^2 + (-2q+4)x. Equating coefficients gives p+1 = q and -p = -2q+4, which simplifies to p = 2. Hence p = 2, corresponding to option B.
